description: Reopen r-sort-3b-memo (General) read-only. Reads (a.ID, b.ID) where a.MK < b.MK, where a.TK < b.TK, and (a.ID, b.ID, StrComp(a.MK, b.MK, 1)) with a.ID < b.ID, over all 17 rows. Asks whether the < relation and the text-mode StrComp over memo values agree with the Text(255) relation over the same values cut to 255 units, and where they differ.
retentionNote: Designed r-sort-3b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
